svg.text: Traffic light, buzzer and reaction game
LP-MSPM0G3519, seen from above, USB unplugged. Add the wires in the numbered order; each number sits at both ends of its wire and in the list below. The schematic shows the same circuit in symbols.
J1 and J2 are the outer columns, J3 and J4 the inner ones; pin 1, 21, 40 and 20 are at the USB end.
Wire colours: red 3.3 V, orange 5 V, black ground; every other colour is one signal.

g.text: Breadboard: holes a to e, and f to j, in one column are joined; each long rail is joined end to end.
Column 1 is at this end; rails and holes count up toward the top.
Wires, in the order you add them
Ground rail (blue, hole 2) to J2 pin 20 (GND)
Bottom ground rail, hole 1 to Top ground rail, hole 1
Place first: 330 ohm resistor, Red LED, Yellow LED, Green LED
Red resistor, breadboard j2 to J3 pin 27 (PB26)
Red LED minus, breadboard j6 to Ground rail
Yellow resistor, breadboard j7 to J3 pin 29 (PB10)
Yellow LED minus, breadboard j11 to Ground rail
Green resistor, breadboard j12 to J3 pin 28 (PB27)
Green LED minus, breadboard j16 to Ground rail
Place first: 330 ohm resistor, Passive buzzer
Buzzer resistor, breadboard j17 to J2 pin 14 (PB7)
Buzzer minus, breadboard j23 to Ground rail
Button B, breadboard j27 to J2 pin 15 (PB8)
Button B, breadboard a29 to Bottom ground rail
330 ohm resistor: one leg in h2, other leg in h5
Red LED: long leg (+) in f5, short leg (flat side) in f6
330 ohm resistor: one leg in h7, other leg in h10
Yellow LED: long leg (+) in f10, short leg (flat side) in f11
330 ohm resistor: one leg in h12, other leg in h15
Green LED: long leg (+) in f15, short leg (flat side) in f16
330 ohm resistor: one leg in h17, other leg in h20
Passive buzzer: + leg in f20, − leg in f23
Button B: leg 1 in f27, leg 2 in f29, leg 3 in e27, leg 4 in e29
Button A (S2, on the board): no wire, the program reads it on J4 pin 40 (PB3).
The buzzer draws about 10 mA through its 330 ohm resistor, within what one pin may give.
Then plug in USB, run the build, and expect
Press S2 or button B when green lights. The terminal prints who was first and the time in milliseconds.
The same circuit as a schematic

svg.text: Fox Red Labs. Pins from the build's pin table, the one the program is built from; the 3D build on the page shows the same wiring step by step. Board picture: TI SLAU947 cover render.
